https://armenopole.com/jeunes-prodiges-d: The Swiss tour of Jeunes Prodiges d'Arménie features works by Komitas, Khachatourian, Rachmaninoff, Liszt and Piazzolla. Organised by Miassine, it stops at Zurich's Chapelle Ste Anna on 24 October. Free admission, registration recommended.
https://armenopole.com/young-prodigies-o: The Young Prodigies of Armenia, a new generation of talented musicians, embark on a Swiss tour from October 24 to 31, 2026. Organized by the Miassine Foundation with support from the Pilossian & Philipossian Foundation, the concerts blend classical, folk, and jazz music across several cities, including Geneva at the ILO and the Armenian Center in Troinex.
https://armenopole.com/ara-malikian-pres: Violinist Ara Malikian and his band blend classical, jazz, Romani music and flamenco in “Intruso”, a virtuosic, genre-crossing performance.
https://armenopole.com/qui-sommes-nous-e: Tigran Yégavian presents his book "Escales Arméniennes" at the Société de Lecture in Geneva. The author explores themes of identity, people, and nation against the backdrop of a multifaceted diaspora.
https://armenopole.com/ateliers-mantis.h: The Armenian Women's Union hosts friendly workshops to prepare mantis for the annual church fair. Maral Torossian, Lilia and Vatché Markoussian lead these sessions open to everyone, including beginners.
https://armenopole.com/prima-del-mito-se: Violinist Sergei Mkrtichian performs "Prima del mito", a solo recital spanning 1720 (Bach, Telemann, Locatelli) and 1820 (Paganini Caprices). Free admission.
https://armenopole.com/benefizkonzert-fu: Anniversary evening marking 25 years of partnership between YMCA Spitak and Cevi Zürich, featuring a live link to Spitak. The collection exclusively supports Cevi Zürich's work in Armenia.
https://armenopole.com/parce-qu-ils-sont: Musical theatre by Pinar Selek, performed by Lorianne Cherpillod and Mathilde Soutter, a committed work resonating as both tribute and reflection on Armenian identity.
https://armenopole.com/55e-grande-fete-a: The 55th Grande Fête Arménienne in Geneva features an oriental buffet, Armenian specialties, traditional dances, and tavli and chess tournaments. Organized by the Union of Ladies of the Armenian Apostolic Church, the event has a warm, festive community atmosphere.
https://armenopole.com/ballet-sheherezad: Italy's national company Balletto di Milano makes its Swiss debut with « Shéhérazade. The Thousand and One Nights », a two-act ballet choreographed by Mella/Torrielli and restaged by Agnese Omodei Sale. Set to scores by Khachaturian and Rimsky-Korsakov, the production dazzles with virtuosic dancing, lavish costumes by Mario Ferrari and Marco Pesta's magical scenography.
